clues.it: Rosa era nella 9ª colonna, accanto a uno scaffale e a nord di Sergio.
clues.en: Rosa was in the 9th column, beside a shelf and north of Sergio.

clues.it: Luca era accanto a una sedia, in una stanza diversa da Olga e in Cambusa.
clues.en: Luca was beside a chair, in a different room from Olga and in the Galley.

clues.it: Fabio era nella 7ª colonna, accanto a una sedia e in una stanza diversa da Irene.
clues.en: Fabio was in the 7th column, beside a chair and in a different room from Irene.

clues.it: Carla era accanto a una pianta e a nord di Giada.
clues.en: Carla was beside a plant and north of Giada.

clues.it: Sergio era nella 3ª colonna e sul Ponte.
clues.en: Sergio was in the 3rd column and on the Deck.

clues.it: Nino era accanto a una lanterna, ma non era accanto a una rete.
clues.en: Nino was beside a lantern, but was not beside a net.

clues.it: Paolo era nella 7ª riga, a nord di Bruno e sul Ponte.
clues.en: Paolo was in the 7th row, north of Bruno and on the Deck.

clues.it: Olga era accanto a una pozza e in una stanza diversa da Paolo.
clues.en: Olga was beside a puddle and in a different room from Paolo.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Giada era nella 4ª colonna e nella 10ª riga, ma non era accanto a una cuccetta.
clues.en: Giada was in the 4th column and in the 10th row, but was not beside a bunk.

clues.it: Irene era nella 11ª riga, accanto a una rete e in Stiva.
clues.en: Irene was in the 11th row, beside a net and in the Hold.

general_clues.en: 5 in the west half of the grid.
5 in the north half of the grid.

steps.it: L'indizio di Rosa lascia una sola casella libera: riga 1ª, colonna 9ª.
steps.en: Rosa's own clue leaves a single free square: row 1st, column 9th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Sergio lascia una sola casella libera: riga 5ª, colonna 3ª.
steps.en: Sergio's own clue leaves a single free square: row 5th, column 3rd.

steps.it: L'indizio di Giada lascia una sola casella libera: riga 10ª, colonna 4ª.
steps.en: Giada's own clue leaves a single free square: row 10th, column 4th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Irene lascia una sola casella libera: riga 11ª, colonna 11ª.
steps.en: Irene's own clue leaves a single free square: row 11th, column 11th.

steps.it: Rosa può stare solo nella 1ª riga: escludendola, a Fabio resta una sola casella: riga 3ª, colonna 7ª.
steps.en: Rosa can only be in the 1st row: ruling it out leaves Fabio a single square: row 3rd, column 7th.

steps.it: Rosa può stare solo nella 9ª colonna: escludendola, a Carla resta una sola casella: riga 4ª, colonna 8ª.
steps.en: Rosa can only be in the 9th column: ruling it out leaves Carla a single square: row 4th, column 8th.

steps.it: Carla può stare solo nella 8ª colonna: escludendola, a Luca resta una sola casella: riga 2ª, colonna 6ª.
steps.en: Carla can only be in the 8th column: ruling it out leaves Luca a single square: row 2nd, column 6th.

steps.it: Sergio può stare solo nella 5ª riga: escludendola, a Nino resta una sola casella: riga 6ª, colonna 1ª.
steps.en: Sergio can only be in the 5th row: ruling it out leaves Nino a single square: row 6th, column 1st.

steps.it: Paolo può stare solo nella 7ª riga: escludendola, a Olga resta una sola casella: riga 8ª, colonna 10ª.
steps.en: Paolo can only be in the 7th row: ruling it out leaves Olga a single square: row 8th, column 10th.

steps.it: Bruno può stare solo nella 9ª riga.
steps.en: Bruno can only be in the 9th row.

steps.it: Nessun altro può stare nella 5ª colonna, e lì a Paolo resta una sola casella libera: la 7ª riga.
steps.en: No one else can be in the 5th column, and it leaves Paolo a single free square there: the 7th row.

steps.it: Nessun altro può stare nella 2ª colonna, e lì a Bruno resta una sola casella libera: la 9ª riga.
steps.en: No one else can be in the 2nd column, and it leaves Bruno a single free square there: the 9th row.
